subject: Renewal + Capacity Increase — procurement gatecheck & onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Lena Ochoa <lena.o@acmegames.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jason Park <jason.park@acmegames.com>, procure@acmegames.com
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + onboarding info needed for PO

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well — our renewal for Redwood Dedicated is coming up (contract ends 2027-06-15). We're planning a 30% capacity increase and a 12‑month term extension, but Procurement needs an updated vendor onboarding packet before they will issue a PO. Specifically they asked for:

- Current SOC 2 attestation or summary
- Updated SOW reflecting the capacity bump and term change
- Standard vendor onboarding form (W-9/contractor info is already on file)

Can you confirm you can provide a SOC2 summary and the redlined SOW by EOD tomorrow? Also, do you have an electronic signing link (DocuSign) ready, or should we coordinate via our procurement portal?

Thanks — Lena
Procurement Manager, Acme Games

From: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
To: Lena Ochoa <lena.o@acmegames.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + onboarding info needed for PO

Lena — thanks for the heads up. We're on it. Quick plan:

- I'll attach a SOC2 summary and a draft SOW with proposed capacity numbers (GPU hours and concurrency targets).
- Marissa will confirm pricing for the 30% uplift and any term discounts.
- Neha will check our DocuSign template; if Acme prefers the portal, we'll upload the executed SOW there as a PDF.

Target: send you the packet by tomorrow 5/5 midday PT. If Procurement has a portal upload step that requires a specific vendor ID, please share the link/ID now.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-04T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal packet / pricing for capacity bump

Adding pricing note: 30% capacity bump (baseline: 200k token-units/month) -> new committed 260k token-units/month. We can offer a 7% term discount for a 12‑month renewal if they commit to the higher capacity. Total list price and discount summary attached in SOW.

Sean — finance will need to confirm PO net-30 vs. net-45 and whether we can accept their procurement portal as formal for invoicing. If Procurement requires a separate remit address or GL code, flag asap.

Marissa
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
To: Lena Ochoa <lena.o@acmegames.com>, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-05T12:16:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding packet + redlines (SOW attached)

Lena — attaching the requested materials: SOC2_Type_II_summary_Acme_Redwood.pdf and SOW_Renewal_v3_redlines.pdf. Key items called out in the SOW:

- Committed capacity: 260k token-units/month (30% up)
- Term: 12 months starting 2027-06-16
- Pricing: includes 7% term discount on committed units
- Invoicing: Net-30; bill to the address listed on the last PO unless Procurement supplies a different remit/GL

Priyom — legal added a small clause to clarify data retention and audit rights for Dedicated deployments. Please review the redline, especially the addendum on audit log retention (30 days vs. previous 14).

If Acme uses their portal, we can upload the final PDF for signature. Otherwise we'll send a DocuSign link.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: SOC2_Type_II_summary_Acme_Redwood.pdf, SOW_Renewal_v3_redlines.pdf]

From: Jason Park <jason.park@acmegames.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Lena Ochoa <lena.o@acmegames.com>, procure@acmegames.com
Date: 2027-05-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet + redlines (SOW attached)

Thanks — received the packet. Procurement says two items remain before they can issue a PO: 1) a short Affirmation of SOC2 status on company letterhead (they won't accept the third-party summary alone), and 2) the SOW must be uploaded to Acme's procurement portal with our vendor ID 84-ACM-77.

Can you provide the affirmation letter and confirm a contact for the portal upload? If you can upload, Procurement will issue PO_78921 within 48 hours of successful upload.

— Jason (IT/Platform Lead)

From: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
To: Jason Park <jason.park@acmegames.com>, Lena Ochoa <lena.o@acmegames.com>, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding packet + redlines (SOW attached)

Jason / Lena — Sean here from Finance. We attached a one-page Affirmation_of_SOC2_on_letterhead.pdf to this reply (signed by our Security Officer). We've also uploaded the final SOW (SOW_Renewal_v3_signed.pdf) to your procurement portal using vendor ID 84-ACM-77.

Next steps from our side:
- Await issuance of PurchaseOrder_78921 (please send PDF to billing@redwoodinference.com)
- Once PO is received, we'll finalize the DocuSign for signature and trigger the capacity provisioning for the 6/16 start date.

If Procurement needs a different remit or GL mapping, loop Logan (cc'ed) and we will update the invoice metadata immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the partnership.

Sean Gallagher
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: Affirmation_of_SOC2_on_letterhead.pdf, PurchaseOrder_78921.pdf (pending receipt)]
